verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair openness question for a SaaS payments and open-banking platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes TrueLayer as a hosted API (Payments, Data and Verification APIs) managed through its Console, with no self-hosted or on-premises deployment option documented. The open-source signing libraries on GitHub and the SDKs are developer building blocks, not the core product, so they earn no credit.
